10:38:14 +0530 DATE : 7th AUGUST, 2025 P.C. :
1.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

2. This is an application for pre-arrest bail in connection with C.R. No. 15 of 2022 registered with Narpoli Police Station, Thane for offence punishable under Section 420 read with Section 34 of IPC and Section 51(a), 51(b) and 63, 64 of Copyright Act,
1957 and read with Section 103 and 104 of the Trade Marks Act, 1999.
3. Admittedly, the Applicant is protected by order dated 23.08.2023.
4. Learned Counsel for the Applicant submitted that the Applicant had only manufactured the cloth using the alleged mark on the basis of order placed by co-accused Mr. Gurcharan Satnam Singh.
It is further submitted that cloth with the logo has not been found at the instance of the Applicant and also not in his premises.

1 5.

Learned APP on instructions of the officer of the concerned Police Station (who is present in the Court) submits that investigation is complete and chargesheet is already filed, so far as co-accused are concerned.

She submits that RCC No. 364 of 2022 is also registered in the Court of JMFC,
Bhiwandi, Thane.
It is submitted that there are no antecedents.

6. Perusal of the FIR indicates that the Applicant was not named in the FIR and his name has surfaced during the investigation as a person who has manufactured the cloth on the instructions of co- accused.

7. Considering the nature of allegations and the fact that chargesheet is already filed against co-accused and case is pending, and further considering the fact that the Applicant was protected by the interim order of this court for last about 2 years, and further considering absence of antecedents,
case for grant of application is made out.
8. The anticipatory bail application is allowed in terms of order dated 23.08.2023.
If the Applicant is chargesheeted, the Applicant is directed to attend the trial, unless exempted by the concerned Trial Court.
9. Anticipatory bail application is disposed of in above terms.

(M.M. SATHAYE, J.)
